verdict.rationale: Sill's privacy docs say there is no account and no server, and that your screen and typing travel only between your own devices. By construction, the vendor never receives user data that could be used for AI training. The only outbound call described is an optional, disableable daily update check to GitHub. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses AI model training, so the guarantee is inferred from the architecture rather than stated. Missing for 10: an explicit no-AI-training policy statement, independent verification of the no-server data flow.
